name: Anthropic's 1-hour cache
gain: Anthropic's words: 1-hour cache writes cost 2 times base input, listed by the vendor; reads stay far below input.
how: cache_control with ttl 1h on the last stable block
replaces: A 5-minute cache that expires between calls.
trade_offs: Writes cost double, so low-traffic prompts may not pay back.
usage_signal: Usage and Cost API: cached input tokens at or near zero on a model with large input

gain_model.formula: input_tokens * input_price * hit_rate * (1 - read_multiplier) - writes * input_price * (write_multiplier - 1)

test_recipe.what_to_compare: input cost and latency, identical answers
